# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We are committed to making participation in Vaultr welcoming and harassment-free for everyone, regardless of age, experience, identity, background, or level of technical knowledge. This is a student-led project: teach generously, assume good intent, and make room for people who are learning.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful, inclusive, and constructive.
- Give and receive feedback professionally.
- Respect privacy and do not share confidential legal material.
- Focus on what is best for the project and its users.
- Accept responsibility, apologize when needed, and learn from mistakes.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, sexualized language or attention, doxxing, deliberate disruption, and publishing private information without permission are not acceptable. Do not submit malicious code, credentials, real client data, or vulnerability details in public channels.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to **security@vaultr.dev** or the repository maintainers privately. Reports will be reviewed fairly and confidentially. Maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, reject contributions, or restrict participation when necessary to protect the community.

This Code of Conduct is adapted from Contributor Covenant 2.1 and applies to all project spaces.
